name: Minimal Single Holder/Account/Permission (F1-F6 Complete Flow)
production_boundary: Bank Issuer OID4VCI (:7000), DAS Token Endpoint (:7000) & Resource Server (:4000)
proven_requirements: Complete end-to-end VDAM protocol execution including fresh Scope VC issuance at F1 with durable issuance-binding commit, F2 delegation request, F3 holder approval with SD-JWT+KB, F4-F5 DAS verification, and F6 Resource Server AIS delivery
uncovered_aspects: The F2-F6 leg is driven through the authorized conformance signers and re-commits the issuance record to the re-signed Scope VC, so the F1 component-digest binding is not exercised by this case.

name: Negative: Wrong Key Binding Audience

name: Negative: Challenge Nonce Mismatch in KB-JWT

name: Negative: Altered Selective Disclosure Hash (sd_hash)
proven_requirements: DAS rejects Holder KB-JWT when sd_hash does not match the SHA-256 digest of the presented SD-JWT

name: Negative: Wrong Grant Audience (Aud_G)
proven_requirements: DAS rejects VP grant assertions targeted at a different authorization service URL

name: Negative: Altered Exact F4 Presentation Binding

name: Negative: Cross-Context Parent and Delegation Pair

name: Negative: Wrong Key Binding Signer

name: Negative: Substituted Signer with Untrusted Replacement-Key Hint

name: Negative: Issuance Record Wallet Certificate Mismatch
